text: Sartre's term for the self-deception in which consciousness flees its freedom by pretending to be a fixed thing (a being-in-itself) is ___ (mauvaise foi).
explanation: Bad faith (mauvaise foi) is Sartre's name for fleeing one's freedom by pretending to have a fixed essence — to be a being-in-itself — as in the over-identified waiter. The expected term is 'bad faith.'
